# Version ceilings for auto-update: "<recipe> <ceiling>",
# one per line; the bound is EXCLUSIVE (new version must
# sort strictly below it). A ceilinged recipe resolves
# upstream from the full tag list filtered below the bound,
# so in-line updates (openssl 3.6.x) keep flowing after the
# upstream moves past the ceiling.
#
# Use a ceiling when a separate recipe tracks the newer
# major line, or when newer upstream tags no longer contain
# the packaged tool.

# 4.x ships separately as openssl4.toml.
openssl 4

# 18.x ships separately as postgresql18.toml.
postgresql 18

# Pinned 0.15.x line; zig.toml tracks current.
zig15 0.16

# flarectl was removed from cloudflare-go after v0.x;
# v4+ tags are the Stainless-generated API library.
flarectl 1
